description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common initialization such as setting up logging infrastructure. It extends FragmentActivity and manages logging setup through custom wrapper classes.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class for Android applications that handles common setup tasks such as logging initialization. It extends FragmentActivity and provides a standardized starting point for other activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the activity is first created; currently invokes super method only.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when the activity becomes visible; here it initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging system by attaching a LogWrapper to the logging chain and logs a 'Ready' message.
